parentalbond.desc: Mold Breaker: moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Eligible attacks hit twice; the second hit deals 80% damage. Existing multi-hit moves, spread hits, charging or delayed attacks, Z/Max moves and moves barred from extra hits are excluded. Contact moves have 1.3x power. Normal- and Fighting-type moves can hit Ghosts. Cannot be suppressed.
parentalbond.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; eligible attacks hit twice; stronger contact moves; hits Ghosts.

ironwill.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, plus a further 25% reduction against super-effective attacks or on Crystal Cavern and Dark Crystal Cavern (40% total). Defense and Sp. Def are 4/3x on Cold Eclipse, Dark Crystal Cavern and Rainbow. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Gains +1 accuracy on entry; tail moves have 1.5x power.

calderacore.desc: On entry, summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures existing freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def.
calderacore.shortDesc: Summons sun; Magma Armor protects and grants field bonuses.

razorcurrent.desc: On entry, summons rain for 5 turns, or 8 with Damp Rock. Gains +1 Speed at the end of each full turn it spends active.
razorcurrent.shortDesc: Summons rain; gains Speed each full active turn.

hauntingveil.desc: Cursed Body + Infiltrator. Damaging hits have a 30% chance to Disable the attacker's move, guaranteed on Haunted Terrain and blocked on Holy Terrain; Disable, Max moves, future moves and Struggle are excluded. On fainting, curses each surviving foe. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist.
hauntingveil.shortDesc: Cursed Body + Infiltrator; has local field and fainting effects.

shadowdouble.shortDesc: After a Ghost hit, next opposing attack deals 25% less damage. Once per switch-in.
shadowdouble.desc: Once per switch-in, damaging an opponent's HP with a Ghost attack creates a shadow double. The next opposing damaging move deals 25% less damage across all its hits. The double lasts until used or switching out. Does not block status effects, fixed damage, or residual damage. Shadow Tag is a separate species passive.

crossfire.shortDesc: Grass hits prime Fire; Fire hits prime Grass. Primed attacks have 1.2x power.
crossfire.desc: Damaging an opponent's HP with a Grass attack primes Fire, and a Fire attack primes Grass. The next damaging attack of the primed type has 1.2x power across all hits and targets, spending the charge even if it misses or is blocked. Repeating the same type keeps the opposite type primed. Status moves and Substitute-only hits do not prime a head; switching clears the charge. Spicy Spray is a separate species passive.

solartrap.shortDesc: Automatic Stockpiles/releases; draining moves hurt their user.
solartrap.desc: Accumulation and Liquid Ooze. Has automatic Stockpiles and releases, defensive effects, and damage to draining attackers. Digestive Sap is not part of this ability.

predator.shortDesc: Extra power against authority and active Ultra abilities, or foes that have not acted.
predator.desc: Doubles attack power against active Ultra Ego, Ultra Instinct and composites containing them. In this matchup only, ignores positive Defense and Special Defense stages and those Ultra damage reductions; negative stages, unrelated defenses and post-hit healing remain. This replaces its first-action bonus and is disabled when the Ultra component is suppressed, including Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Terrain. Existing authority bonus remains: 2x against Neutralization, or Royal Decree/Empress without active Neutralization. Otherwise newly switched or pending-action targets take 1.3x power, 2x on Mountain/Snowy Mountain/Rocky, or 1.5x on Fairy Tale/Dragon's Den/Big Top. Has stat-stage inversion unless Contrary is supplied by its species passive.

auraprecision.desc: Shield Dust blocks secondary effects aimed at this Pokemon while retaining attacker self-effects. Technician multiplies eligible move power by 1.5 at effective base power 60 or less, or 80 or less on Factory Terrain. Does not add extra hits or Inner Focus. Aura Guard is a separate species passive.

ultraego.desc: Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field.
ultraego.shortDesc: Ignores abilities; damage dealt or taken heals; qualifying hits boost attacking stats; field bonuses.

perfectego.desc: Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field. Moves cannot miss, including on the suppressing fields.
perfectego.shortDesc: Never misses; heals and gains stats in combat.

primalego.desc: When attacking, ignores the target's Defense, Sp. Def and evasion stages. When defending, ignores the attacker's Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk and accuracy stages. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field.

burningego.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic. On Cold Eclipse, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry instead and cannot burn through contact. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field. On Cold Eclipse, the two entry effects together give +2 Defense and Sp. Def.

unleashedego.desc: Ultra Ego + Levitate + Raging Storm. Airborne unless grounded. Damaging hits from foes raise Attack and Sp. Atk once until it uses an attack; heals 1/16 max HP on that hit and 1/20 on further hits. Dealing attack damage heals 1/16 once per turn. Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale add once-per-entry Defense/Sp. Def boosts for physical/special hits and a one-use 1/4-HP pinch heal. Royal Decree or Empress enables 1.3x power (except against Battle Bond) and 0.7x incoming damage unless Neutralization is active. Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy fields disable Ultra Ego effects. Raging Storm bypasses abilities, screens, Substitute and defensive stat stages; +1 critical-hit ratio. Attack KOs splash 60% of the recorded hit damage onto remaining foes, or grant +1 Attack if no splash damage is dealt. Incoming priority damage is halved. Immune to hail; cannot be suppressed. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.
unleashedego.shortDesc: Ultra Ego boosts/healing; airborne; bypasses defenses; KO splash.

divinemockery.desc: Full local Hydra Bond, Mold Breaker and extra Water STAB. Does not grant Sniper, entry accuracy or an additional critical-hit multiplier. Mold Breaker is supplied separately on species with that passive.

verdantsanctuary.desc: On entry, sets Grassy Terrain and Hospitality heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP. Friend Guard reduces damage to allies to 3/4. No Invigorate healing multiplier or adjacent status cure. Grassy Surge is supplied separately on species with that passive.
verdantsanctuary.shortDesc: Grassy Terrain on entry; Hospitality and Friend Guard.

mastercourse.desc: Reverses received stat-stage changes except Z-Power; Contrary is supplied separately on species with that passive. Once per turn, dealing opposing HP damage with a Water or Dragon attack prepares a nonstacking +1 critical-hit-stage charge after the entire move finishes. Give it to the living adjacent ally with the lowest HP percentage, or to itself if none exists. The next executed damaging move consumes the charge even on a miss, protection or immunity; status moves preserve it, and switching clears it. A successful charged Water or Dragon move can prepare another charge afterward.
mastercourse.shortDesc: Water/Dragon HP hits charge an ally, or itself alone, after the move.
